items.content_html:
In conversation with jtojnar, upstream maintainer of file-roller in the NixOS GNOME matrix chat and part of NixOS GNOME team

Wed 03 Sep 2025 02:03:04 PM EDT

@normalcea:matrix.org: paging thoughts: I think file roller should be removed from the default install selection since it's not part of GNOME core apps/suite, it's also not seen any new releases outside of bugfix ones and conflicts with Files built-in de-archiving mechanism

@jtojnar:matrix.org: Agreed, I thought I have already removed it. (BTW I am one of the upstream maintainers.)

Removes the file-roller program module from nixos as it's not required for the program to function. This requires adjusting pantheon and cinnamon desktop modules as well as removing file-roller entirely from GNOME as it's not part of the GNOME core applications.
